newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Telecom Argentina proposes tariff changes.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Argentina proposes tariff changes.

text.p: Telecom de Argentina said on Tuesday it had presented proposals to the government for sweeping changes to telephone fees, cutting the cost of long-distance calls while raising those of local services.

Under the proposals -- exactly the same as those issued by fellow telecommunications company Telefonica de Argentina earlier on Tuesday -- the cost of international calls would be cut by around 60 percent. Local peak hour calls would become dearer and residential subscribers would have to pay double their current telephone rental.
Telecom de Argentina is controlled by France Telecom.
